title: Me and My Friend SMP
description: a bunch of mods mostly create and war stuff
body:
This modpack is for me and my friend but you can use it it's mostly consist of war combat and stuff like that with create and CC I also would like to continue updating this modpack both for my SMP and for you guys outsiders

This adds Guns from legendary mods like TaCZ while having more advance weaponry like Create and Ballistix while also having technical aspect like CC: Tweaked,Electricity and Mekanism this modpack is meant to bring people(multiplayer) together to be a team because to earn progress in this modpack you most likely need a team this modpack will(maybe) help you and your friend get along this modpack is mostly PvP stuff but being team based progression can be fun&tighten bonds between you are peoples with the experience you get with this.
